title: The crons without a Healthchecks check page through GitHub instead, free

source.ref: §7c, Upgrade Healthchecks.io; Daniel chose the free route 2026-11-03 (cost beats speed, no paid upgrade)

detail: Healthchecks.io's free plan holds 20 checks and vercel.json declares about 40 jobs, so every job in CRON_UNMONITORED had no alert. Each of those jobs now stamps its last success into cron_run_markers (key cron-ok:<job>, no new table), and GET /api/status/cron-freshness compares each stamp with the job's freshness window (503 when one is stale or the read fails; a job that has not reported yet is listed, not failed). The queue-watch GitHub workflow reads it every 20 minutes, so a stale job is a red run that GitHub emails. No env var, no migration, no paid plan. Runbook updated.

verify.evidence: Route, stamp writer, workflow step and tests are present; the wrapper test pins a stamp on a healthy run of an unmonitored job and none on a failed run or a monitored job.
